DIAGNOSIS READY: Gouty Arthritis (Tophaceous or acute recurrent flare).

The clinical picture of severe nocturnal pain, swelling, NSAID resistance, and normal CBC in a young male strongly supports a crystal-induced etiology like gout. The slightly elevated ESR indicates inflammation consistent with this diagnosis. I have requested the X-ray and ultrasound images to look for tophi or joint effusion to confirm this.
